codeEmail.subject: Your code to confirm you're a parent or guardian
codeEmail.text:
Your code is {code}.

Enter it on Friends of Animals to confirm you're a parent or lawful guardian. It works for {minutes} minutes. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email: nothing changes without the code.

Friends of Animals

teenInvitationMessage.subject: Your own login on Friends of Animals
teenInvitationMessage.email:
Hello {child},

{guardian} has invited you to your own login on Friends of Animals, linked to them as your parent or guardian. With it you can take part in FOA's competitions yourself.

To accept, open this link, then sign in or create an account with this email address:
{link}

The link works until {expiresAt}. If you weren't expecting this, you can ignore this email.

Friends of Animals
